import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p=params
    tr = p[0]*t**p[1]*np.exp(-p[2]*A*t)
    sl = p[3]*A**p[4]*np.exp(-p[5]*A)*t**p[6]
    base = p[7]*t**p[8]*A**p[9]
    return -(tr+sl+base)
